verdict.rationale: Bench documents a built-in "AI Categorization Assistant": the user describes a transaction's purpose and the assistant identifies its category in real time. That is a genuine in-product AI assistant, but it is narrowly scoped to transaction categorization guidance; broader task delegation is handled by human bookkeepers. missing for 10: a general-purpose assistant that accepts and executes delegated tasks beyond categorization, evidence that the assistant takes actions rather than only suggesting categories, depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Just describe the purpose of the transaction, and the AI Categorization Assistant identifies it in real-time.
